_comment: Per-category standard dimensions (cm) + LIDAR semantic match parameters. semantic_match_radius_m = XY distance threshold. z_range_m = [min, max] elevation ABOVE LOCAL GROUND for which this category is plausible (meters). Cells whose elevation is outside the range are not labeled with this category, preventing e.g. a floating tree from being labeled 'guardrail' or a ground lane-paint point from being stolen by 'sign'.

height_barrier.notes: overhead clearance gantry — wide radius for cross-member reach

traffic_light.notes: radius covers horizontal arms reaching across lanes. Lower bound dropped from 2.5 to 0.5 so the pole column from base to head is captured; nearest-distance rule keeps ground paint assigned to ground categories.

sign.notes: Sign head height; the lower bound 0.3 m includes the pole base, and ground paint stays with lane via nearest distance. Sensitivity: elevation window narrowed by 0.25 m at each end (sign 0.55-3.25 m); radius 2.0 m.

street_light.notes: tall lamp posts. Lower bound dropped from 4.0 to 0.5 so the full pole column appears; radius 2.5m covers the horizontal arm.

_lidar_defaults.notes: cells whose elevation is below ground_elevation_threshold AND not matched to a ground category fall to 'unknown' — treated as curb/shoulder noise.

_comment_revision: sensitivity: infrastructure elevation windows narrowed by 0.25 m at both ends; radii unchanged
